Container.Name: putio-sync
Container.Overview: Unofficial sync daemon for Put.io, not affiliated with Put.io. It downloads finished Put.io transfers to the array, sends .torrent and .magnet files from a watch folder to Put.io, and acts as a download client for Radarr and Sonarr. A web UI on port 15432 sets it up and shows the queue, transfers and stats. On first start it prints a setup code in the container log; open the web UI and enter the code, or the Web UI token below.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Where finished Put.io downloads go. Choose this folder (/downloads) in the setup wizard.

Config.Name: Watch folder
Config.Description: Optional: .torrent and .magnet files dropped here are sent to Put.io

Config.Name: Web UI token
Config.Description: Optional: a token for the web UI and API. It also unlocks the setup wizard. Leave empty to use the setup code from the log.

Config.Name: Metrics
Config.Description: Prometheus metrics, when enabled in Settings

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: error, warn, info, debug or trace
